label: TP
reason: Both alerts (java/xss and java/tainted-format-string) involve the resolved sink value 'bar' being user-controlled. Param is derived from a user-provided parameter name (via request.getParameterNames()), which is then placed into valuesList and ultimately assigned to 'bar'. Since the parameter name is attacker-controllable, the format string and HTML output contexts are vulnerable. Alert 1 (java/xss): bar is used in a format string without validation. Alert 2 (tainted-format-string): bar is directly used as the format string. Case TP: at least one alert-TP.

evidence.note: Param is assigned from user-provided parameter name, then added to valuesList.
Bar is resolved to user-provided parameter name (from valuesList.get(0)) and used in format string.
